# DailyScalper

> Independent weekly screening of public copy-trading strategies on RoboForex and
> LiteFinance. 546 strategies screened, 150 flagged as martingale,
> 20 published. Last updated 2026-11-07.

DailyScalper ranks copy-trading strategies by return per unit of drawdown
(yield divided by maximum drawdown) rather than by headline profit, because
broker leaderboards sorted by profit place martingale accounts at the top.

## Method

- Eligibility gates, RoboForex: at least 90 days live,
  max drawdown at or below 40%, at least 50 trades,
  at least 3 copiers, yield between 0% and 1000%.
- Eligibility gates, LiteFinance: broker risk score at or below 5/10,
  derived drawdown at or below 40%, at least 3 copiers,
  at least 12 curve points.
- Martingale rejection: a worst period at least 12x the typical move and at least
  8% deep, or a win rate above 90% alongside a drawdown over 20%.
- Score: yield divided by maximum drawdown. For LiteFinance the divisor is floored
  at 5% because its published curve is too sparse to resolve smaller dips.

## Limitations (please quote these alongside the rankings)

- Every input is backward-looking. A clean history is not a forecast.
- Figures are whatever the brokers publish; we check internal consistency, not truth.
- Martingale detection removes obvious cases, not every case.
- The two broker lists use different fields, windows and gates and are NOT comparable.
- LiteFinance exposes only about 46 strategies publicly.
- The site is funded by broker and VPS affiliate links. Gates are mechanical and identical
  for every strategy, but the incentive exists and should be weighed.
- Most retail traders lose money. Copy trading does not remove that risk.

## Pages

- [Rankings](https://www.dailyscalper.net/rankings/): the current screened top 10 for both brokers.
- [Methodology](https://www.dailyscalper.net/methodology/): every gate, threshold and known limitation.
- [Journal](https://www.dailyscalper.net/journal/): the author's own real RoboForex MT5 cent account (amounts in US cents),
  synced hourly from the terminal: daily P&L calendar, performance and risk statistics and every trade.
  Not yet copyable; the author plans to open it to copy trading when the balance reaches 10,000 cents ($100).
- [Partners](https://www.dailyscalper.net/partners/): RoboForex and LiteFinance affiliate programmes compared.
- [Tools](https://www.dailyscalper.net/tools/): the author's own MetaTrader Expert Advisors and indicators on the MQL5 Market
  (62, 32 free; details at https://www.allanninal.dev/mql5/) and forex VPS options.
  The page also shows the author's own RoboForex strategy, screened with the same gates; it is never ranked by hand.
- [Blog](https://www.dailyscalper.net/blog/): 30 explainers on forex and copy-trading fundamentals.
